description: List published marketplace opportunities (offers/requests) of an event, paginated. Use get_opportunity for one entry's full details. Resolves the menu path automatically; pass path to override.

after.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

path.description: Optional event menu path (e.g. /components/<id>) from get_event navigation; omit to resolve it automatically.

name: list_opportunities
